svg.title: agent-harness: the deny floor, doctor and sync-global (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop: four agent commands pass through the shared dispatch.py hook. Each is parsed into argv tokens, checked against the repository tier, and denied, allowed or sent for a human ask. Then harness doctor checks the live wiring, and sync-global previews a diff before an explicit apply with a backup and rollback receipt. The floor is not a sandbox.
svg.text: shared dispatch.py hook · argv deny floor · tier.json · doctor · sync-global (diff first) · not a sandbox
sandbox + branch protection = the hard boundary
An agent pushes --force to main: argv is parsed, the tier is checked, and the floor denies it
rm -rf / never gets through, on any tier
A draft PR is fine on tier 2: allowed
A network write needs a human: ask
doctor inspects the live wiring first. Installation is never implicit
sync-global shows the diff before it writes anything
--apply makes a backup and a receipt, so rollback is one compare-and-swap
